sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-07-01. Page lists per-resident furnishings: extra-long twin bed (triples include a bunk bed & a lofted bed), desk, chair, dresser, mirror, closet, plus a Microchill refrigerator/microwave combo. No numeric dimensions stated.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Facilities Drawing Requests
sources.notes: Process source only. No drawing dimensions have been obtained yet.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3 room interior photos
sources.notes: Official page photo gallery (confirmed 2026-07-01). Look-only; no image data copied. Establishes: light natural-wood furniture incl. wood bed frames, black rolling task chairs, blue carpet, dark window frame with radiator below, desk shelf hutches. Triple depiction: two desks under the lofted bed, third desk against exterior wall, dresser at foot of bunk. No numeric dimensions.

layout_constraints.description: Loft (left side wall) and bunk (right side wall) both have their HEADS at the window wall, per the official 3D views and the official room photo (beds tight to the window).
layout_constraints.subject: bed_group

layout_constraints.description: Entry door sits at the upper-left corner of the entry (interior) wall; it swings inward with a clear zone in front.
layout_constraints.subject: door_1

layout_constraints.description: Two closet modules (wardrobe + open shelf column) are built along the entry wall to the right of the door.
layout_constraints.subject: closet_group

layout_constraints.description: Two desks form a continuous study nook under the loft; the third desk stands against the window wall facing the window.
layout_constraints.subject: desk_group

layout_constraints.description: dresser_1 stands along the entry wall right of the closets, drawers opening into the room near the bunk-foot corner; dresser_2 sits in the loft-foot corner against the left side wall, drawers to the room - the position the official view shows, kept clear of the 0.9 m door swing.
layout_constraints.subject: dresser_group

layout_constraints.description: Microchill stands on the right wall's entry band between the closet line and the bunk's foot, door facing the open room (representative placement near the entry).
layout_constraints.subject: microchill_1

Bathrooms are community bathrooms located on each floor, not inside the room.
